unified_master_json.title: Complete Unified Astrological Methodology, Calculation, Delineation, Strength Weighting, and Synthesis Reference

normalization_notes: Removed duplicated concepts by preserving the most explicit formula and retaining alternates in variant fields.
Grouped formulas into deterministic computational stages from input capture to final interpretation.
Preserved both Western tropical and Vedic sidereal branches and made conversion points explicit.
Added weighting model unifying qualitative delineation and quantitative strength scores.
Added machine-friendly schema sections for downstream parsers, scoring engines, and report generation.

quality_checks: Validate coordinates are numeric and in valid terrestrial bounds.
Normalize clock time to ISO timestamp with zone.
Resolve DST transitions explicitly for ambiguous timestamps.
Record uncertainty window in minutes for rectification-sensitive analyses.

pipeline.notes: East/west sign handled by longitude convention; retain seconds precision.

substeps: Get sidereal time at 12:00 noon LMT for reference year and base meridian.
Compute time interval from local noon.
Subtract interval for AM births, add for PM births.

ayanamsha.policy: Prefer table-based or astronomical library values over linear approximation for production.

house_systems.placidus: Trisect diurnal/nocturnal semi-arcs using iterative cusp solving.
house_systems.koch: Birthplace method using MC degree semi-arc trisection.
house_systems.whole_sign: House 1 is full sign containing ASC degree.
house_systems.sripathi_porphyry: Trisect ecliptic arcs between angular points.

robustness_rules: Use iterative numerical solver with convergence threshold ≤ 1 arcsecond for quadrant systems.
Fallback to tabular interpolation if solver fails at extreme latitudes.
Document house-system dependency in all delineation outputs.

western_timing.solar_arc: All points advanced by directed solar motion (~0.9856°/year to ~1°/year)

scoring_framework.total_score_scale: 0-100 per planet, 0-100 per house, 0-100 per theme

component_details.Shadbala_norm: Normalize rupas to configured threshold for each graha.
component_details.Dignity_norm: Exaltation, own sign, moolatrikona, friend, neutral, enemy, debility mapped to 0-100.
component_details.Ashtakavarga_support: Bindu support in sign/house with threshold bands.
component_details.Aspect_quality: Benefic vs malefic net aspect matrix.
component_details.Motion_state: Retrograde, combust, stationary, direct speed class adjustment.

rule_layers: Validation modifiers (cross-check D9/D10 and event resonance)
narrative_protocol: Annotate benefic and challenging pathways for each theme.
Attach time windows from period systems and transit triggers.
State uncertainty and alternate outcomes if scores are close.
Provide practical recommendations tied to strongest remedial/strategic levers.

rules.dominance_rule: If a slow planet remains within configured orb for prolonged interval, elevate eclipse-lord theme weight by +20% to +40%

documented_case_2000.inference: Prolonged Neptune activation associated with covert, diffuse, ideologically charged collective events.
documented_case_2000.paired_market_data: S&P 500 entries preserved as event-linked contextual series, not deterministic causal proof.

houses: Equal and Whole Sign direct construction
periods: Secondary progression and solar arc rules

engineering: Use high-precision ephemeris library (Swiss Ephemeris or equivalent) for production.
Store every intermediate value (with units) to enable auditability.
Implement deterministic rounding policy at final rendering only.
Keep formula versioning so reports can be reproduced exactly later.
interpretation_ethics: Treat correlations as interpretive, not deterministic proof.
Avoid fatalistic language in person-level readings.
State uncertainty explicitly when birth-time quality is low.
Separate symbolic inference from empirical market/economic claims.
